sample_artifact.title: Synthetic Q3 network capex board summary
sample_artifact.instructions: Draft a board summary of the synthetic Q3 network capex plan, preserving every figure. Use one section each for the headline, the spend split, phasing and risks, and the decision requested. Cite the source ID after each figure.

evidence.text: Synthetic Q3 2026 network capex plan. Total approved capex is 412.6 million AED, of which 61 percent (251.7 million AED) is 5G radio. Fibre backhaul is 98.4 million AED and core and IT is 62.5 million AED.
Phasing: 38 percent of the spend falls in July, 35 percent in August and 27 percent in September. 1,240 new 5G sites are planned by the end of Q3.
Risks: radio equipment lead times are 14 weeks, and vendor contracts priced in USD carry a 6.5 percent currency exposure.
The board is asked to approve a contingency of 20.6 million AED, 5 percent of the plan.

figures.label: New 5G sites by end of Q3
